host.description: Your Exsited API host name, without https://.

post.description: Exchanges your API credentials for an access token. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN` on every other call. The SDKs make this call for you and renew the token before it expires.

grant_type.description: `client_credentials` for a new token, or `refresh_token` to renew one.

client_secret.description: The secret paired with the client ID.

redirect_uri.description: The redirect URI registered for your integration. Required with `client_credentials`; not sent with `refresh_token`.

refresh_token.description: With `refresh_token` only: the `refresh_token` from an earlier token response.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the token expires, for example `3600`.

refresh_token.description: Exchanged for a new access token when this one expires.

302.description: The credentials were not accepted. The API redirects to its sign-in page instead of returning an error body, so this page shows `redirect to unsafe URL blocked`.

get.description: Returns accounts under `data`, with `pagination` for the next page. Narrow the listing with `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>` for other tests, such as `filter_created_on_gte` or `filter_email_address_contains`. Every filterable field also takes `_neq`; the text fields take `_contains` and `_not_contains`, and `created_on` and `last_updated_on` take `_gt`, `_gte`, `_lt` and `_lte`. The primary contact filters as `filter_contact1_<field>` and a custom attribute as `filter_attribute_<name>`.
